storefront_api.name: Storefront API
storefront_api.info: The lookbook sections fetch product data at runtime through the Storefront API. Without a token they will render nothing on the storefront and show guidance here in the editor.

token.label: Storefront API access token
token.info: Settings → Apps and sales channels → Develop apps → your app → API credentials → Storefront API access token. This token is public by design and grants read-only access to published products. Never paste an Admin API token here.

version.label: API version
version.info: Pinned so a Shopify release cannot silently change the response shape. Shopify versions quarterly as YYYY-MM.

lookbook.label: Lookbook
lookbook.info: Manage lookbooks in Content → Metaobjects → Lookbooks.

show_compare_at.label: Show compare-at price
show_compare_at.info: Shown only when the compare-at price is higher than the current price in the shopper's market.

settings.explanation: This section shows the lookbooks that contain the product being viewed, up to two of them, ordered by each lookbook's priority. There is no lookbook picker: which lookbooks apply is a property of the product, not of this placement.
